title: Income & Expense Tracking System
description: Build an intuitive expense tracking module with category tagging, vendor selection, receipt attachment upload, and tax-deductible expense marking.
acceptanceCriteria: User can log one-time and recurring business expenses
Categorization dropdown with standard tax categories (Office, Travel, Software, Utilities)
Summary statistics update dynamically when expenses are added or edited

steps.details: Build ExpenseTable and AddExpenseModal with shadcn/ui components.
Implement CRUD queries via Supabase client with active organization filter.
